meta_description: Sheffield Electrician providing domestic and commercial electrical services. Fast, reliable, and fully insured. Call 07810 551230 for your free quote today.
hero_eyebrow: Part P Certified — 24/7 Emergency Callouts Available
hero_subhead: Electrical fault or broken socket in Sheffield? We arrive fast, diagnose on the spot, and fix it right first time.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full rewires and new installations, we handle every electrical job with care and precision.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Blown fuses, blown circuits, or lights out? We're on call 24/7 to get your power back on safely. Most jobs diagnosed and fixed the same day.

services.title: Domestic Rewires
services.desc: Complete house rewires for older properties or full refurbishment projects. We bring your electrics up to current Building Regulations and test everything thoroughly.

services.title: Socket & Switch Installation
services.desc: New sockets, USB outlets, or light switches exactly where you need them. All work certified and installed to BS 7909 standards.

services.title: Boiler & Heating Electrical Work
services.desc: Electrical connections for new boilers, immersion heaters, and heating system upgrades. We co-ordinate seamlessly with your heating engineer.

services.title: Fault Finding & Testing
services.desc: Can't locate an electrical fault? We use diagnostic equipment to pinpoint the issue quickly and explain what needs fixing before you agree to anything.

services.title: EICR Inspections & Reports
services.desc: Professional electrical condition reports for landlords, property sales, or peace of mind. Identifies any safety issues and provides a detailed action plan.

about_pullquote: I started this because I hated seeing neighbours ripped off by cowboys.
about_para_1: I've been an electrician in Sheffield for 18 years, working on everything from Victorian terraces to modern extensions across the city and surrounding areas. I trained to City & Guilds Level 3 and Part P certified, and I've completed over 2,400 domestic and commercial jobs. Every job, big or small, gets the same attention to detail — your home is as important to me as my own.
about_para_2: Customers come back because I turn up on time, explain what's wrong in plain English, and charge fairly. I've built my reputation on trust — no hidden bills, no shortcuts, and work guaranteed for 12 months. Sheffield's a small city; word travels fast, and I'm proud that most of my work now comes from repeat customers and their referrals.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had an absolute nightmare with a burned-out circuit board at 11pm on a Tuesday. Called and explained the problem, and Mark was here within 45 minutes. He diagnosed it straight away, sourced the part, and had everything back online by 1am. Charged a fair price and even checked the rest of the house while he was at it. Absolutely brilliant — will definitely use again.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: Needed a full rewire on a 1970s semi. Mark gave a detailed quote, explained what he'd do and why, and completed the whole job in four days with minimal disruption. All tested and certified. Professional, clean, and no faffing about. Can't fault him.
reviews.author: Susan M.

reviews.text: Our landlord asked for an EICR report and I panicked it would be expensive. Mark came out, checked everything, gave us a full written report, and charged a very reasonable rate. He even explained which things could wait and which were urgent. Highly recommend him.
reviews.author: James T.
